summary: Iteration 12 — HCP Storefronts. Backend 18/18 pytest PASS (100%). Frontend mostly PASS with 1 HIGH bug: admin override route /admin/hcp/:userId/storefront is missing from App.tsx <Switch> → page renders 404 even though AdminHcpStorefrontEditPage is imported. Public storefront (/hcp/dr-admin-test) renders profile + captures ar360_hcp_referral localStorage. HCP dashboard (/hcp/dashboard) renders all editor fields (enabled-toggle, slug, welcome, bio, upload-headshot/banner, save-storefront-btn) and saves successfully. Checkout shows blue 'Order will be credited to: Admin User' card with remove-hcp-referral-btn. Order attribution verified end-to-end: POST /api/orders with hcpReferralSlug='dr-admin-test' snapshots hcpReferralId/Name/Slug, hcpCommissionPercent=12, hcpCommissionAmount=round(totalAmount*12/100). Order without slug + order with unknown slug both correctly omit commission fields.

minor.issue: SLUG_RE allows single-char slugs (regex is `^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{1,48}[a-z0-9])?$` — the outer non-capturing group is OPTIONAL, so 'a' matches). The 400 error message claims '3-50 characters' but the validator accepts 1-char. Tighten to `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,48}[a-z0-9]$` (min 3) to match the message.

Review said discoverability is OFF / no directory page, but routes/hcp_storefront.py:129 exposes GET /api/hcp/storefronts listing all approved+enabled HCPs. Either remove this endpoint or gate behind admin auth to match the stated product requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Route for /admin/hcp/:userId/storefront is MISSING from the <Switch>. AdminHcpStorefrontEditPage is imported (line 40) but no <Route path="/admin/hcp/:userId/storefront" ...> is registered → navigating there returns '404 Page Not Found'. Admin cannot edit HCP storefront or set commissionPercent from the UI.

passed_tests: GET/PUT /api/hcp/me/storefront (auth as admin-HCP) with welcome/bio/featured products
PUT /api/hcp/me/storefront commissionPercent is silently ignored (stays at 12)
POST /api/orders without referral → no commission fields
POST /api/orders with unknown slug → no attribution
Regression: GET /api/products len==39, POST /api/login admin OK
Frontend: public storefront /hcp/dr-admin-test renders + localStorage ar360_hcp_referral captured

Frontend: /hcp/dashboard editor renders all data-testids (storefront-enabled-toggle, storefront-slug-input, storefront-welcome-input, storefront-bio-input, upload-headshot-btn, upload-banner-btn, save-storefront-btn) and save works
Frontend: /checkout shows referral card + remove-hcp-referral-btn when ar360_hcp_referral is set
failed_tests: Frontend: /admin/hcp/{userId}/storefront → 404 Page Not Found (missing route in App.tsx)
action_items: FRONTEND HIGH: Register the admin override route in /app/frontend/src/App.tsx — add `<ProtectedRoute path="/admin/hcp/:userId/storefront" component={AdminHcpStorefrontEditPage} requireAdmin={true} />` (AdminHcpStorefrontEditPage is already imported). Without this, admin cannot set commissionPercent via UI.
BACKEND MINOR: Tighten SLUG_RE in hcp_storefront.py to require min 3 chars to match the 400 error message wording.

BACKEND MINOR: Decide on GET /api/hcp/storefronts directory — either remove it or admin-gate it; it currently exposes all approved/enabled HCPs publicly which contradicts 'Public discoverability is OFF' in the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: hcp_storefront.py PUT /hcp/me/storefront silently drops ADMIN_ONLY_FIELDS (commissionPercent) rather than returning a 400/403 — quiet drop is fine but could be clearer.
routes/orders.py correctly snapshots commission AFTER discount (uses final totalAmount) — good behaviour.
routes/orders.py uses datetime.utcnow() which is deprecated in Python 3.12+ (already flagged in iteration 11).
App.tsx: AdminHcpStorefrontEditPage is imported but never routed — either dead import or missing route; evidence from iteration tests: the route is missing and admin gets 404.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (3/4 flows). Public storefront + HCP dashboard + checkout referral all work; admin override page is 404 due to missing route.

seed_data_creation: Left admin storefront slug='dr-admin-test' enabled as requested. Reset welcome message to 'Welcome to my storefront!' and bio to 'Experienced in sports medicine and recovery.' at end of run. A handful of TEST orders remain in the orders collection (shippingAddress starts with 'TEST') from the order-attribution tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 18 backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_hcp_storefront.py, all isolated and session-scoped. The single frontend failure (admin override 404) is confirmed by grep: /app/frontend/src/App.tsx imports AdminHcpStorefrontEditPage at line 40 but lacks a <Route> for /admin/hcp/:userId/storefront. Once added, retest by logging in as admin, navigating to /admin/hcp/69a74a0ce5b1b6ab12650618/storefront, and verifying commission-percent-input is present + save persists. Backend PUT /api/admin/hcp/{id}/storefront is already verified working with commissionPercent=12.
rca_of_the_issue: Frontend admin override page 404 — ROOT CAUSE: App.tsx has the import but no matching <Route path="/admin/hcp/:userId/storefront">. Reproduction: login as admin at /admin-login, navigate to /admin/hcp/{userId}/storefront → renders wouter's 404 fallback. Mitigation (1-line change): add `<ProtectedRoute path="/admin/hcp/:userId/storefront" component={AdminHcpStorefrontEditPage} requireAdmin={true} />` near the existing /admin/hcp route (App.tsx:85).
